project_scope.note: Texas persimmon is the local anchor; American persimmon is the primary comparison target in the study-batch plan.

priority: flower position on current vs previous-season growth
study_strategy.warning: Fruit color is helpful when present, but leaf underside, shoot position of flowers, and fruit/ovary pubescence make the comparison robust.

quick_key.if: small 2–5 cm leaves with tomentose undersides + smooth peeling bark + pubescent black fruit
larger 6–15 cm leaves + glabrous yellow-orange to dark-red fruit
